result.question: What do five men from Dan want in Laish?

readings.answer: To take possession of the land in Laish.
To attack the people of Laish.
readings.support: let us go up against them

assessments.reason: The scouts urge, “Do not hesitate to go there and take possession of the land,” which directly matches taking the land to settle there.
They also say, “let us go up against them,” which supports an intent to attack; this is the means toward the stated goal of taking possession, so it is a weaker but text-supported reading.
